verdict.rationale: The API exposes most of what the Brave Search UI offers. That includes web, image, video, news and local/place search, suggestions, spellcheck, rich results, AI summaries and answers, and Goggles re-ranking. It also covers search operators, freshness and date filters, country targeting and safesearch, all drawn from the same index that powers Brave Search. The interactive playground also maps directly onto the API endpoints. However, no evidence shows that dashboard functions are API-accessible, such as key creation, usage, billing or plan changes. Plan switching appears to require cancelling and re-signing up through the account. No published OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity claim, API access to account/key/billing/plan management, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
